subject: MAP: metrics & artifacts delivery for GreenByte POC

Subject: POC: MAP + perf artifacts for GreenByte evaluation

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — GreenByte's evaluation team wants to formalize the MAP and include concrete performance artifacts (latency distributions, throughput under target concurrencies, TTFT samples and percentiles, and a simple CSV export we can drop into our perf dashboards).

Top asks from our side:

- The benchmark plan (hardware, dataset, concurrency targets) and expected run window
- Deliverables: slides for exec readout, CSV exports of raw token-level metrics, and a dashboard link we can share with our infra team

Target close: within the next 3 weeks if the MAP and results look good. Can you share a draft MAP and a proposed bench plan by Thursday?

Best,
Sara Mendoza

GreenByte AI

1) Discovery call (tomorrow) to lock dataset and concurrency targets (you + infra).
2) Karthik runs controlled perf tests (we'll capture TTFT, p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput at 1/2/4/8/16 concurrent sessions).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: POC: MAP + perf artifacts for GreenByte evaluation

Adding the bench run plan here. High level:
- Target hardware: 8xA10G (Redwood Dedicated test pool) — we will document exact instance IDs in the run log.
- Model variant: rwd-7b-quant (matched to hosted latency profile)
- Dataset: 500 prompt candidates + 100 long-context stress prompts supplied by GreenByte (we'll request sample set)
- Concurrency targets: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 sessions; sustained runs of 3000 generated tokens per session for throughput stability
- Metrics captured: TTFT (time-to-first-token) per request, per-token latency, CPU/GPU utilization, and throughput (tokens/sec)
- Expected run time: ~3 hours including warm-up; we will keep a live dashboard up during the run.

Plan to run Fri 2026-11-06 03:00–06:00 UTC (low-traffic window). I'll post the perf_run_config.yml to the Drive link and push results (CSV + dashboard snapshot) to the folder.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: perf_run_config.yml (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@greenbyte.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Perf run results (draft): GreenByte POC — initial metrics

Hi all —

We completed the scheduled run. Summary below (draft):

Key observations:
- TTFT: median 45ms, p90 120ms, p99 240ms (rwd-7b-quant, sequence length ~512)
- Throughput: sustained 13.2k tokens/sec at 8 concurrent sessions; drops to ~11.4k tokens/sec at 16 sessions after throttling kick-in
- Latency distribution: p50 per-token latency 6ms, p90 18ms, p99 62ms
- Concurrency behavior: warm-up cost ~20–30s for KV cache; sustained outputs stable after first 300 tokens

Deliverables uploaded:
- throughput_latency_results.csv (token-by-token export, with timestamp and request id)
- ttft_samples.csv (sampled first-token latencies per prompt)
- Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.console/metrics/teams/greenbyte/summary?run=20261106-01

Notes / caveats:
- The run used an isolated Dedicated pool to reduce noisy-neighbor variance; numbers may vary slightly on hosted multi-tenant instances.
- We captured GPU utilization traces and full run logs if you want deeper analysis.

Next steps: consolidate a one-page executive summary and a 10-slide deck for your leadership team. I'll hand the consolidated CSV over to Nikhil for packaging.

-Karthik

Attachment: throughput_latency_results.csv, ttft_samples.csv
